extent: metropolitan France (Corsica included, overseas departments excluded)
why_short_of_plan: time-boxed: GBIF occurrence-search latency rose from ~25 s to ~280 s per species during the run, so the queue was stopped after the agreed hour. The queue is ordered by record count, so the species downloaded are the best-recorded ones.

sampling.strata: 6 year bands x 2 latitude bands per species
